english.note: Use this as the all-purpose way to say that something is not important or noteworthy.
This is the all-purpose choice for something unimportant or of little significance.
This is the all-purpose choice for something too unimportant to matter.
Use this for a fault, issue, or detail that lacks importance, rather than for a person's character.
Use this when little means unimportant or of little significance rather than physically small.
Choose this when slight means unimportant or insignificant, such as an error that does not matter.
